title: Rules
subtitle: Deterministic routing rules, evaluated in priority order.
emptyDisabled: No deleted rules or old versions.
emptyDescription: Create a rule to start routing emails automatically.
statsNotReachedHint: No email has reached this rule yet
deactivatedBadge: Deleted or replaced by a newer version — history kept
versioningNotice: Saving creates version {next} — version {current} will be deactivated, not deleted. Its history (evaluations made under it) remains intact.
deactivateConfirmDescription: "{name}" stops matching new emails right away. Its past decisions stay in the history and audit log.
emptyGroup: No conditions in this group yet.
name: Name
errPriorityInteger: Priority must be a whole number.
errDestinationEmpty: Destination must not be empty (or use the reserved value "human_review").
errGroupEmpty: {path}: must have at least one condition
simDescriptionRule: Runs this rule as it is in the form, unsaved, over emails that already arrived, and shows where they would have gone. Nothing is saved and no email is moved.
simDescriptionGraph: Runs this graph as it is in the form, unsaved, over emails that already arrived, and shows where they would have gone. Nothing is saved and no email is moved.
simDescriptionEntry: Runs this entry as it is in the form, unsaved, over emails that already arrived, and shows where they would have gone. Nothing is saved and no email is moved.
simFailed: The simulation could not be run.
simTruncated: More emails matched this period; only the newest {n} were checked.
simWithoutAnalysis: {n} had no Jev analysis, so they can only go to Human Review.
simForcedToReview: {n} were sent to Human Review by Jev's review signal before any rule runs.
simDecidedByGraph: {n} came from mailboxes that use a rule graph, so rules don't apply to them.
simNoEmails: No emails arrived in this period.
exportHint: Download the active rules as a JSON file
importHelp: Choose a file exported from Eumaeus, or paste JSON: either the exported file or an array of rules with name, priority, conditions and destinationRef. Destinations are matched by name.
prioritiesAppend: Put them after the current rules
previewReadyReplace: {rules} ready to import; every current rule will be turned off.
previewInvalid: Nothing can be imported until these are fixed. Nothing was saved.
fieldDescBusinessHours: True when the email arrived during your organization's working hours. If working hours aren't set, this condition never matches.
fieldDescIsReply: True when the email is a reply (it has In-Reply-To or References). Unknown for emails received before this version — then the condition never matches.
fieldDescFirstEmail: True when no earlier email from this address reached your organization.
fieldDescEmailsLast24h: How many emails came from this address in the 24 hours before this one.
deleteFailed: The rule could not be deleted.
impactChecked: Checked {count} emails from the last {days} days.
impactChecked_one: Checked {count} email from the last {days} days.
impactChecked_other: Checked {count} emails from the last {days} days.
impactRiskyDescription: These look like customer, finance or security mail. Check them before you go on.
impactAcknowledge: I understand business mail will move to {to}.
impactReviewHint: Check the impact below, then save again to confirm. Changing the form discards this check.
impactFailed: The impact of this change could not be checked.
deleteImpactTitle: Deleting this rule moves business mail
deleteImpactDescription: Without this rule, some business emails would go to a junk-like destination.
historyHelp: Every saved version of this rule. Going back saves the chosen version as a new one — nothing is deleted.
historyDeletedNote: This rule is deleted. You can bring it back with any of its versions.
historyDiffers: Differs from the current version in: {fields}
historyConfirmDescription: v{version}'s name, priority, destination and conditions are saved as a new version. The current version stays in the history.
historyRestoreDescription: The rule starts matching new emails again, as v{version} was. Its history stays one chain.
historyPriorityTaken: That priority is now used by another rule. Pick a free one:
historyFailed: Couldn't go back to that version.
historyRiskyTitle: Going back would move business mail
historyLoadFailed: The history could not be loaded.
fieldDescSpf: The mail provider's SPF result for the sender: pass, fail, softfail, neutral, none… Unknown for emails received before this version or without a verdict — then the condition never matches.
fieldDescDkim: The mail provider's DKIM result (the best of the message's signatures): pass, fail, none…
fieldDescDmarc: The mail provider's DMARC result for the From domain: pass, fail, none…
fieldDescAuthenticated: True when the sender is verified: DMARC passed, or SPF or DKIM passed for the From domain. A good guard against lookalike senders on allow rules.
notifiesHint: This destination also emails people when a rule sends mail here (Email notification channel).
